incidents_catalogued.title: Resolution of Missing Pretrained Backbone and Canonical State Reconstruction
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: EXP07_DIAG01 lacked local ImageNet-pretrained backbone and relied on a non-canonical random initial state.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Official resnet18-f37072fd.pth downloaded from official PyTorch URL, cryptographically verified with complete SHA256 F37072FD47E89C5E827621C5BAFFA7500819F7896BBACEC160B1A16C560E07EC. Previous non-canonical random state preserved without destruction.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Historical C16 downloaded weights dynamically on Kaggle without persisting them to local repository.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Pretrained weights provisioned, verified, and mapped in exp07_diag01_initialization_lineage_v1.json. Status advanced from BLOCKED to READY_FOR_NEXT_PREFLIGHT.

remediation_summary: All scientific initialization blockers resolved. Canonical state reconstructed with 100% determinism. Zero training occurred. Ready for the next zero-step preflight rehearsal.
